address: Advanced College of Engineering and Management, 14 Bhuwaneshwari Marg, Kathmandu, Bagmati Province 44600
summary: A real-time social platform where groups share photos and video in shared spaces. A ~383k-line Flutter codebase on iOS and Android, live on the App Store and Google Play.
highlights: Built the GitLab CI/CD pipeline: every merge ships to TestFlight and Play Internal Testing, with one-click production releases to both stores, using fastlane on a self-hosted Mac runner.
Added a 1-minute preflight stage that catches signing, secret and version errors before a 30-minute build, and a collision-free build-number scheme for dev and prod builds.
Work on a custom camera stack: a forked camerawesome with Kotlin and Swift patches for 120 fps slow motion, time-lapse, HDR, lens switching and stabilisation.
Built native features over 8 MethodChannels, including a StoreKit 2 purchase bridge in Swift, WidgetKit and Android home-screen widgets, and an iOS share extension.
Work on offline-first uploads that survive the app being killed, using durable SQLite intents, idempotency keys and S3 multipart resume, so a retry never duplicates a post.
Work on real-time chat and calls: 11 Socket.IO namespaces, end-to-end encrypted messages, and WebRTC calls with CallKit and ConnectionService.
Tuned feed and video performance with a device-tier model for prefetch depth, buffers and decode sizes. Also contribute to the Next.js web client.

summary: Built Flutter apps across mobile, web and desktop, and on some projects the Django backend behind them too.
highlights: Architected BhansaGhar, a restaurant platform that works offline over the local network or online through the cloud, with WebSocket order updates under 50 ms (Flutter + Django).
Led the Chwasha Jhol MOMO food-ordering app from start to release, and designed its UI and prototypes in Figma.
Built the Flutter client for N9Nrms, an attendance and leave system on Android, web and desktop, cutting manual tracking by about 80%.
Built the player side of an LMS video app with BLoC and protected HLS/DRM streaming.
Contributed to a multi-cloud monitoring app with Riverpod, map integrations, 2FA and biometric login.
